title: Breaking Bad第一季
text: 绝命毒师...很好看，发现了如此尤物的美剧....第一季就是老白患病，故事从这里开始了....这个沙漠内裤的场景的倒叙很巧妙👍
textEn: Breaking Bad is... so good. I can't believe I found such a gem of an American TV series. Season one begins with Walt's diagnosis, and that is where the story takes off.... The flash-forward to the desert scene—with him standing there in his underwear—is brilliantly done. 👍
